_meta.confidence: gameplay-derived — material quantities estimated from crafting tier where not explicitly stated

goals.name: Radiant Paladin Armor Set
goals.description: Endgame heavy armor set that scales from level 13 to 25. One of only three scaling armor sets in the game. Found in gold chests throughout Albaneve Summits.
progression_steps: Reach Level 13+ (scaling continues to 25)
Unlock Blacksmith (Springlands — rescue order #1)
Advance through Springlands → Revelwoods → Nomad Highlands → Kindlewastes → Albaneve Summits
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 5
Farm gold chests in Albaneve Summits for Radiant Paladin pieces
Craft any missing pieces at Blacksmith if blueprint drops

goals.name: Sunpiercer Armor Set
goals.description: Fixed level 25 endgame heavy armor. Highest physical resist in the game (~250). Essential for tank builds at endgame.
progression_steps: Reach Level 25
Advance to Albaneve Summits (final biome)
Farm gold chests in Albaneve Summits for Sunpiercer pieces
Defeat Fell Dragon for upgrade materials (optional but recommended)

goals.name: Wailing Blade (Legendary)
goals.description: S-Tier Two-Handed Greatsword. Highest raw damage in the game, cleaves 3 targets per swing. Legendary version drops from Fell Dragon.
goals.location: Fell Dragon drop (Kindlewastes - Dragon's Peak) or craft at Blacksmith
progression_steps: Reach Level 25-30
Upgrade Flame Altar to max level
Travel to Kindlewastes — Dragon's Peak (-1400, 1600)
Defeat Fell Dragon (~15% drop rate for legendary version)
Alternatively craft Steel version at Blacksmith with Steel Bars + Hardened Leather
Upgrade to Legendary with Dragon Scale x3 + Steel x20

goals.name: Ignited Bow
goals.description: S-Tier Bow with fire arrows. Safest DPS weapon in the game — range + fire damage. Essential for Archer and Assassin builds.
progression_steps: Rescue Hunter (Springlands, rescue order #5)
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 4
Collect Steel Bars from Kindlewastes nodes
Collect Hardened Leather from high-level beasts
Craft at Hunter workstation

goals.name: Scorching Wand
goals.description: A-Tier Magic Wand. Fireball AoE with good INT scaling. Mainhand weapon for Battlemage/Mage DPS builds.
progression_steps: Rescue Alchemist (Springlands, rescue order #2)
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 3
Collect Iron Bars from Revelwoods/Nomad Highlands nodes
Collect Shroud Cores from Shroud enemies
Craft at Alchemist workstation

goals.name: Guardian Shield
goals.description: A-Tier Shield. Best parry window and block stamina reduction. Essential for all sword-and-board and tank builds.
progression_steps: Rescue Blacksmith (Springlands, rescue order #1)
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 4
Collect Steel Bars from Kindlewastes nodes
Craft at Blacksmith workstation

goals.name: Eagle Eye Armor Set
goals.description: Scaling medium armor set (level 13-25). Best endgame armor for Ranger and Assassin builds. Found in Albaneve Summits gold chests.
progression_steps: Rescue Hunter (Springlands, rescue order #5)
Advance to Albaneve Summits
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 5
Farm gold chests in Albaneve Summits for Eagle Eye pieces

goals.name: Hailcaster Armor Set
goals.description: Fixed level 23 light armor. Best mage DPS armor before endgame. Found in Kindlewastes gold chests.
progression_steps: Advance through Revelwoods → Nomad Highlands → Kindlewastes
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 4
Farm gold chests in Kindlewastes for Hailcaster pieces

goals.name: Dragonbone Bow (Legendary)
goals.description: Legendary bow dropped by Fell Dragon. Highest ranged DPS potential in the game. ~20% drop rate.
goals.location: Fell Dragon drop — Kindlewastes, Dragon's Peak (-1400, 1600)
progression_steps: Reach Level 30
Upgrade Flame Altar to max level
Travel to Kindlewastes — Dragon's Peak (-1400, 1600)
Defeat Fell Dragon (~20% drop rate)
Repeat if not dropped (boss respawns after a few in-game days)

goals.name: Unlock Blacksmith
goals.description: The Blacksmith is the most important NPC — unlocks Glider, Grappling Hook, metal tools, and all weapon/armor crafting.
goals.location: Ancient Vault - Blacksmith, north of Cinder Vault. Coordinates: (-150, 80)
progression_steps: Exit Cinder Vault and commune with The Flame
Place your first Flame Altar
Craft a Summoning Staff (1 Twig — auto-recipe)
Travel north from the starting area to the Ancient Vault
Navigate the vault and rescue Oswald Anders
Return to base and use Summoning Staff to place the Blacksmith

goals.name: Craft Glider
goals.description: The Glider is the #1 priority item after the tutorial. Unlocked by the Blacksmith. Transforms exploration and survivability.
progression_steps: Rescue Blacksmith (Ancient Vault north of Cinder Vault)
Enter Shroud zones and cut down Shroud trees for Shroud Wood
Kill Shroud enemies for Shroud Spores
Craft String from plant fibers at Workbench
Return to Blacksmith and craft the Glider

goals.name: Craft Grappling Hook
goals.description: Essential mobility tool. Allows reaching elevated areas and crossing gaps. Unlocked after Blacksmith rescue.
progression_steps: Rescue Blacksmith
Collect Metal Scraps from broken structures and ruins
Craft String from plant fibers
Craft at Blacksmith workstation

goals.name: Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 3
goals.description: Flame Altar Level 3 unlocks Revelwoods access, Iron crafting tier, and mid-game content. Critical progression milestone.
progression_steps: Upgrade to Flame Altar Level 2 first (5 Shroud Liquid, 10 Stone, 5 Wood)
Farm Shroud Liquid from Shroud enemies
Farm Shroud Spores from Shroud enemies and plants
Gather Stone and Wood from anywhere
Interact with Flame Altar and select Upgrade

goals.name: Defeat Fell Warden
goals.description: First major boss. Springlands melee brute. Recommended level 6-7. Gateway to mid-game content.
progression_steps: Reach Level 6-7 minimum
Craft or upgrade to Copper weapon or better
Cook food buffs (Grilled Meat for HP)
Bring 50+ arrows for safe ranged strategy
Place a temporary Flame Altar near the arena for respawn
Fight: dodge ground slam, attack after charge misses, kill adds

goals.name: Defeat Fell Dragon
goals.description: Endgame multi-phase boss. Kindlewastes. Requires max preparation. Drops legendary materials.
progression_steps: Reach Level 30
Max out Flame Altar level
Equip full fire resist gear
Craft 10+ Greater Healing Potions (Alchemist)
Cook max food buffs
Place temp Flame Altar near Dragon's Peak
Phase 1: Dodge fire breath, attack during recovery
Phase 2: Move constantly during flight phase, ranged attacks
Phase 3 (Enrage): Save burst damage, avoid lava pools

goals.name: Build a Castle Base
goals.description: Build a large fortified castle base. Choose a strategic location with natural defenses and resource access.
goals.location: Recommended: Highland Mesa (950, -700) — one access path, natural fortress
progression_steps: Rescue Carpenter (Springlands, rescue order #3)
Upgrade Flame Altar to Level 3 for expanded build area
Scout a defensible location (Highland Mesa recommended)
Place a new Flame Altar at the chosen location
Gather Stone, Wood, and Iron Bars in bulk
Build foundation, walls, and roof using advanced pieces from Carpenter
Add NPC rooms, crafting stations, and storage (Magic Chests from Carpenter)

goals.name: Unlock All 5 Core Craftspeople
goals.description: Rescue all five core NPCs: Blacksmith, Alchemist, Carpenter, Farmer, and Hunter. Unlocks the full crafting ecosystem.
progression_steps: 1. Rescue Blacksmith — Ancient Vault north of Cinder Vault (-150, 80)
2. Rescue Alchemist — Ancient Vault west of Springlands Spire (-260, -40)
3. Rescue Carpenter — Ancient Vault southwest of Low Meadows Spire (-80, -120)
4. Rescue Farmer — Ancient Vault north of Springlands Spire (50, -180)
5. Rescue Hunter — Ancient Vault east of Springlands Spire (120, -40)
Build individual sheltered rooms for each NPC (walls + roof + bed required)

goals.name: Unlock All Backpack Upgrades
goals.description: Expand your inventory from the base size to Large Backpack (+24 slots). Requires Hunter and Bard rescues.
progression_steps: Rescue Hunter (Springlands, rescue order #5) for Small Backpack
Craft Small Backpack at Hunter (Tanning Station)
Upgrade to Medium Backpack with more Leather + Linen
Rescue Bard (Blackmire — requires Level 12+ and Revelwood Spire)
Craft Large Backpack (+24 slots) at Bard
